briefings.headline: Hunt your pitch and make Gilbert work
briefings.message: Logan Gilbert is the high-confidence starter pick. Righties, be ready to attack fastballs; Yandy Díaz and Ryan Vilade have batter edges, while Junior Caminero and Jonathan Aranda have even matchups. Lefties should stay disciplined against his offspeed, and everyone should protect with two strikes against his 27.2% strikeout rate. Expect his slider and splitter to challenge you; make him prove he can land the splitter/changeup for strikes. Andrés Muñoz is Seattle’s rested closer to watch late.
reminders: Attack fastballs when you get your pitch.
Avoid chasing offspeed, especially as a left-handed hitter.
Be ready for rested late-inning relievers, including Andrés Muñoz.
